uvPolicy: Broad horizontal ground surfaces use serialized material texture transforms derived from renderer world bounds so macro/detail texture density is expressed in real metres instead of per-primitive 0..1 UV scale.
antiRepetitionPolicy: Each surface uses a long-period macro map plus a separate short-period detail albedo/normal layer. Paving macro/albedo contains no painted joint grid because physical paving joints are modeled as geometry by QualityBlockGroundDetailUpgrade.
prohibited: painted paving joints that duplicate modeled joints
material variation without a material/manufacturing cause

profiles.materialFamily: maintained summer turf over compacted topsoil
profiles.physicalReasoning: Long-wave turf vigor/thinning follows moisture and mowing heterogeneity; short-wave variation represents blades, thatch and small exposed soil flecks rather than random dirt.
profiles.frontLightResponse: Very broad, weak non-metallic highlight; blade/detail normal keeps the surface from reading as a flat green card.
profiles.grazingLightResponse: Rough grazing response remains broad; small normal relief creates restrained sparkle breakup without metallic glints.
profiles.shadeResponse: Color saturation decreases modestly but local blade/soil contrast remains visible through normal and albedo detail.

profiles.materialFamily: aged mineral plaza/path paving with physical saw-cut/recess joints modeled separately
profiles.physicalReasoning: Macro variation represents aggregate/cement-batch and exposure differences; detail represents fine aggregate and surface abrasion. No joint line, sun highlight or arbitrary grime is baked into the maps.
profiles.frontLightResponse: Diffuse mineral response with a weak broad dielectric highlight; physical joint geometry supplies joint shadowing.
profiles.grazingLightResponse: Aggregate micro-normal slightly strengthens the broad grazing highlight without producing polished or metallic streaks.
profiles.shadeResponse: Aggregate contrast remains restrained and readable; no painted AO or light direction is present in base color.

profiles.materialFamily: dry compacted pedestrian shortcut soil with fine gravel
profiles.physicalReasoning: Macro value changes represent compaction/moisture retention and fines distribution; detail represents grains/pebbles. Foot-traffic direction and rain runoff remain separate cause-based overlays/geometry.
profiles.frontLightResponse: Extremely broad matte response with small granular breakup and no glossy wet look in the dry benchmark.
profiles.grazingLightResponse: Grain relief becomes more legible but remains rough and non-metallic.
profiles.shadeResponse: Dry soil remains matte; broad macro tone persists without directional lighting baked into albedo.

surfaces.interfaceLogic: Underlying continuous turf field; paving, soil and curb assemblies sit above it while later transition geometry may expose/trim verge edges.
surfaces.aging: summer UV, mowing/thatch, localized thinning near repeated pedestrian access

surfaces.interfaceLogic: Mineral plaza slab; physical 12 mm joint recess geometry and precast curb modules define construction seams rather than texture lines.
surfaces.aging: abrasion, aggregate exposure, UV and wash variation; stains only where drainage/contact sources exist

surfaces.interfaceLogic: Mineral park path bounded by modeled precast curb modules; world-phase texture offset avoids an arbitrary UV restart at object origin.
surfaces.aging: pedestrian abrasion and rainfall exposure with no baked directional grime

surfaces.interfaceLogic: Compacted shortcut soil between low edging; broad field material is continuous while edging geometry supplies a physical transition.
surfaces.aging: compaction, fines migration and dryness; runoff remains cause-based

surfaces.interfaceLogic: Compacted soil shortcut with globally phased macro/detail texture transforms so the material scale does not reset visually at the object origin.
surfaces.aging: compaction, fines migration and dryness; runoff remains cause-based

lookdevBrief: At native 4K inspect hero ground_contact, oblique vegetation_grounding and grazing tree_shadow_contact crops. Reject if paving repeats as an obvious grid, if physical joint geometry is visually duplicated by texture, if grass/soil reads as a flat card, or if texture scale changes between adjacent surfaces without a physical reason.
